map.需水量大就等于要多灌水吗？: High water need means more irrigation?
map.不一定，要看降雨补给。半湿润区降雨可覆盖大半需水，真正要靠灌溉补的只是『缺口』，: Not necessarily; watch rainfall recharge. In semi-humid areas rain covers most need; irrigation only fills the "gap"; blindly irrigating full ETc causes waterlogging waste.
map.Kc 分段怎么取？: How to take Kc by stage?
